articles.title: 美国能源部首次就TRIG煤气化技术发出非独占许可
articles.summary: 美国能源部HGEO宣布与Latitude Energy Services执行首个TRIG煤气化技术非独占许可，仅限电力领域。技术由能源部与产业伙伴联合开发，面向低阶高水分煤，此次许可被视为技术转移与商业化的一步。
entities: 碳氢化合物与地热能办公室
articles.new_facts: 美国能源部碳氢化合物与地热能办公室首次执行TRIG煤气化技术非独占许可，被许可方为Latitude Energy Services，仅限电力领域；Latitude独立持有工业领域权利；TRIG由能源部与产业伙伴联合开发，针对低阶高水分煤。
articles.limitations: 来源为美国能源部官网文章，属官方公告。文中未披露许可费、装机规模、效率或成本参数，也未说明是否已有商业运行项目，故无法判断技术成熟度处于示范还是商业阶段。页面标注日期为10月16日，结构化datePublished为10月15日，报道时间以结构化时间为准。

facts.text: 美国能源部碳氢化合物与地热能办公室10月15日宣布，该部已与Latitude Energy Services执行首个TRIG煤气化技术非独占许可，范围仅限电力领域。Latitude另独立持有该技术在工业领域的权利，此次许可与之互补。

evidence.quote: The Department has executed its first-ever nonexclusive license with Latitude Energy Services for the Transport Integrated Gasification (TRIG™) technology.
Latitude independently holds the rights to TRIG™ in the industrial field of use, which will be complemented by this license.

facts.text: TRIG是由美国能源部与产业伙伴联合开发的煤气化系统，设计针对低阶、高水分煤。能源部称，此次许可被视为该项联邦共同开发技术转移和商业化的重要节点，并为美国煤炭行业增加商业部署机会提供路径。

The executed license marks a significant milestone in the technology transfer and commercialization of a federally co developed advanced coal gasification system

facts.text: 公告未披露许可费、项目装机规模、气化效率或成本数据，也未说明是否已有商业运行项目，因此尚不能判断该技术当前处于示范还是商业阶段。

evidence.quote: The license is limited to the power field of use.

bilingual.title_en: US Department of Energy Issues First Non-Exclusive License for TRIG Coal Gasification Technology

sentences.en: The U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Hydrocarbons and Geothermal Energy announced on October 15 that the department has executed its first non-exclusive license for TRIG coal gasification technology with Latitude Energy Services, covering the power sector only.
sentences.zh: 美国能源部碳氢化合物与地热能办公室10月15日宣布，该部已与Latitude Energy Services执行首个TRIG煤气化技术非独占许可，范围仅限电力领域。

sentences.en: Latitude separately holds the rights to the technology in the industrial sector on its own, and this license is complementary to those rights.
sentences.zh: Latitude另独立持有该技术在工业领域的权利，此次许可与之互补。

sentences.en: TRIG is a coal gasification system jointly developed by the U.S. Department of Energy and industry partners, designed for low-rank, high-moisture coal.
sentences.zh: TRIG是由美国能源部与产业伙伴联合开发的煤气化系统，设计针对低阶、高水分煤。

sentences.en: The Department of Energy said the license is regarded as an important milestone in the transfer and commercialization of this federally co-developed technology, and provides a path to expand commercial deployment opportunities for the U.S. coal industry.
sentences.zh: 能源部称，此次许可被视为该项联邦共同开发技术转移和商业化的重要节点，并为美国煤炭行业增加商业部署机会提供路径。

sentences.en: The announcement did not disclose the license fee, project capacity, gasification efficiency or cost data, nor whether any commercial operating project exists, so it is not yet possible to determine whether the technology is currently at the demonstration or commercial stage.
sentences.zh: 公告未披露许可费、项目装机规模、气化效率或成本数据，也未说明是否已有商业运行项目，因此尚不能判断该技术当前处于示范还是商业阶段。
